    OpenAI to end partnership with Cursor after SpaceX acquisition

    PUBLISHED: August 31, 2026 at 10:01 AM PDT | UPDATED: August 31, 2026 at 11:04 AM PDT
    Getting your Trinity Audio player ready...

    By Yi Wei Wong, Bloomberg

    OpenAI said it will end its partnership with Cursor after the AI-coding agent’s acquisition by SpaceX, according to a post on X.

    Related Articles

    • Gwyneth Paltrow scraps Sam Altman Hamptons party after anti-AI outrage: reports
    • OpenAI claims its new chips can outperform Nvidia processors in tests
    • Tech deploys charm offensive to combat AI data center backlash
    • OpenAI launches ChatGPT for Teens, promising a more age-appropriate chatbot
    • OpenAI agrees to $3.2M settlement after feds accuse it of discriminating against U.S. workers

    In a separate post on its website, OpenAI said it has informed Cursor that it will wind down their contract with a proposed shutoff date of Nov. 12.

    “We are making this choice because we cannot be confident that SpaceX will use our technology within our terms of service, based on our experience with Elon Musk’s companies violating contracts,” the post read.
